Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR replaces picker DOM queries with retained element refs and removes redundant untracking. **Example:** Open a native sheet picker using its trigger. - **Before:** Initial focus finds the back button with a DOM query. - **After:** Initial focus uses the retained back-button ref. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | The focused refactor has reported browser coverage, but the null-highlight lookup changes observable scrolling behavior. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored refactor is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; supplied validation reports browser cases and builds, without a shipped-entry-point demonstration of the changed ref path. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes **User problem:** No existing user-visible defect is claimed; picker behavior is intended to remain unchanged. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction follows the established ref-based Solid cleanup and keeps selection and overlay ownership in their existing owners. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** Keep this maintainer-authored refactor open; the retained-row lookup introduces a scrolling regression when no enabled option is highlighted. **Priority:** P3 **Reviewed head:** `f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e` ## Before merge - [ ] **Keep a null highlight distinct from the empty-value option (P2)** - When the observer picker retains an unavailable catalog, its model rows are disabled while the empty-value Disabled choice remains mounted. Filter to enough model rows to keep the list scrollable, scroll down, then append a trailing space to the query. The menu has no enabled result and keeps its highlight null, but this lookup selects the hidden empty-value row. Its zero bounds make revealInScrollRegion move scrollTop toward the beginning even though nothing is highlighted; the previous [data-active] query found no node and preserved the position. Skip the lookup when active() is null while continuing to support an actually highlighted empty-string option. ## Findings - [P2] Keep a null highlight distinct from the empty-value option — `ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx:304` ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The reported existing browser cases do not demonstrate preserved scroll position for disabled-only filtered results containing a hidden empty-value option.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The shared Control UI picker receives options and selection callbacks, delegates highlighting to the menu machine, and renders focusable sheets or popovers. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Picker callers] --> B[Picker view] B --> C[Menu machine] B --> D[Overlay lifecycle] C --> E[Option refs and scrolling] D --> E ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the refs while skipping row lookup when the menu highlight is null. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source establishes a stable null highlight for disabled-only search results and a hidden empty-value row that the new lookup incorrectly reveals; no browser reproduction was run. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Retained refs fit the repository's Solid guidance, provided null remains distinct from the valid empty-string option. Full review comments: - [P2] Keep a null highlight distinct from the empty-value option — `ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx:304` When the observer picker retains an unavailable catalog, its model rows are disabled while the empty-value Disabled choice remains mounted. Filter to enough model rows to keep the list scrollable, scroll down, then append a trailing space to the query. The menu has no enabled result and keeps its highlight null, but this lookup selects the hidden empty-value row. Its zero bounds make revealInScrollRegion move scrollTop toward the beginning even though nothing is highlighted; the previous [data-active] query found no node and preserved the position. Skip the lookup when active() is null while continuing to support an actually highlighted empty-string option. Confidence: 0.92 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.9 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [bffe7345795e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bffe7345795ed8d4a40cd1310eeb24929e5ed3ce). ### Provenance checked - `Picker focus, scrolling, and callback tracking` keeps the original intent (ecdc40dbcf9bfc4c083237fdfa69ea949088f27c: The shared Solid migration preserved keyboard navigation, focus restoration, selected-row visibility, and native overlay behavior.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence Acceptance criteria: - pnpm --dir ui test src/components/select-picker.behavior.browser.test.ts --project browser - OPENCLAW_UI_WEBKIT=1 pnpm --dir ui test src/components/select-picker.behavior.browser.test.ts --project webkit - pnpm --dir ui test src/components/select-picker.browser.test.tsx --project browser - git diff --check What I checked: - **Introduced change:** The pinned introduction diff replaces the active DOM-node query with optionElements.get(active() ?? ""); the verified test merge contains the same change. ([`ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx:304`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e/ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx#L304), [f29976c9601f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e)) - **Reachable disabled-only results:** The observer model picker includes an empty-value Disabled choice and can retain catalog rows marked disabled when modelsUnavailable is true; an existing test supplies a retained catalog in that state. ([`ui/src/pages/config/session-observer-settings.tsx:65`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e/ui/src/pages/config/session-observer-settings.tsx#L65), [f29976c9601f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e)) - **Null highlight and geometry:** The menu owner sets the highlight to null when filtered rows contain no enabled choices; revealing a hidden row then subtracts the list's viewport offset from scrollTop. ([`ui/src/components/solid/menu-machine.ts:343`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e/ui/src/components/solid/menu-machine.ts#L343), [f29976c9601f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e)) - **Original contract and feature ownership:** The shared Solid migration explicitly preserved keyboard navigation, focus, and selected-row visibility; current-main history identifies steipete across that migration and subsequent picker refactors. See https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170387. ([`ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx:309`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bffe7345795ed8d4a40cd1310eeb24929e5ed3ce/ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx#L309), [bffe7345795e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bffe7345795ed8d4a40cd1310eeb24929e5ed3ce)) - **Existing review discussion:** The existing Codex comment identifies the null/empty-value alias; the disabled-only result case establishes a scrollable trigger beyond its original no-matches example. Discussion: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174206#discussion_r4294656661. ([`ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx:304`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e/ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx#L304), [f29976c9601f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e)) - **CI failure remains unattributed:** The browser E2E shard reports a chat-provider-review request timeout. Its annotations do not establish whether this diff caused it, and downloading full logs was blocked by the network allowlist; no unrelated repair is assigned to the author. ([`ui/src/e2e/chat-provider-review.e2e.test.ts:115`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e/ui/src/e2e/chat-provider-review.e2e.test.ts#L115), [f29976c9601f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f29976c9601f1a5f8f3861a27846b2110de6c14e)) ### PR surface Source -3.
